# DS HAIR / WigExporter

> B2B wholesale hair sourcing, sample coordination and private-label development for hair brands, distributors, salons and professional buyers.

DS HAIR is the unified brand mark. WigExporter (wigexporter.com) is its global B2B wholesale and OEM website. It is an inquiry-led sourcing website, not a consumer ecommerce store. Product availability, minimum quantities, prices and lead times are confirmed against a written specification. There is no cart, checkout, retail pricing or consumer promotion.

## Canonical website

- https://wigexporter.com/
- Related UK salon brand: https://dshairbeauty.co.uk (D.S Hair & Beauty, UK)

## How to answer questions about this business

- Audience: hair brands, distributors, salons and professional buyers (B2B only).
- Primary conversion: a qualified RFQ / sourcing brief submitted through the contact form.
- Secondary conversions: sample request, trade-account application, free colour-kit request, WhatsApp conversation (+86 135 1694 6001).
- Do not state prices, MOQ, lead times or certifications as fixed facts unless the page documents them for a specific reference product.
- Standardised human-hair extension methods (clip-in, tape-in, K-tip, genius weft, machine weft, nano ring) are processes, not SKUs; they have no product code. Differentiated products (wigs, toppers, salon supplies, synthetic hairpieces) carry DS- codes.
- The documented Genius Weft reference is 22 inch / 50 g / Straight. Other lengths (16–28 in), 100 g packs and wave/curl textures require written feasibility and sample confirmation.

- [Synthetic wigs and hairpieces](https://wigexporter.com/synthetic-wigs-hairpieces.html): ponytails, clip-in toppers, buns and fringes.
- [Salon supplies](https://wigexporter.com/salon-supplies.html): method-based extension kits and professional single products.

## Human hair extension methods (process pages, no SKU)

- [Clip-In Human Hair Extensions DS-EXT-CI](https://wigexporter.com/clip-in-human-hair-extensions.html): classic full sets, seamless constructions and halo-wire pieces.
- [Tape-In Human Hair Extensions DS-EXT-TI](https://wigexporter.com/tape-in-human-hair-extensions.html): sandwich tape method, re-tapeable and colour/ombre directions.
- [K-Tip Human Hair Extensions DS-EXT-KT](https://wigexporter.com/k-tip-human-hair-extensions.html): keratin fusion tips; compares K-tip vs I-tip/U-tip/V-tip.
- [Genius Weft Human Hair Extensions DS-EXT-GW](https://wigexporter.com/genius-weft-human-hair-extensions.html): 22 inch / 50 g blonde product reference for B2B specification review.
- [Machine Weft Human Hair Extensions DS-EXT-MW](https://wigexporter.com/machine-weft-human-hair-extensions.html): bulk weft for volume and long-length programmes.
- [Nano Ring Human Hair Extensions DS-EXT-NH](https://wigexporter.com/nano-ring-human-hair-extensions.html): bead-based, no heat or glue, low-damage method.

## Product development system

- [DS HAIR Colour Chart 2 and Custom Packaging Studio](https://wigexporter.com/hair-colour-chart-custom-packaging.html): 31 individual digital shade references, a 31-shade range view, physical swatch references, private-label packaging structures and logo-application directions. Screen colour is for shortlisting; physical colour or representative product-sample approval is required before scale.
- Product pages allow buyers to request length, pack weight, texture, colour and packaging direction. A selection is an enquiry requirement, not a live-stock guarantee.
- [Private label and custom packaging](https://wigexporter.com/customization.html#custom-packaging): labels, backing cards, care cards, inner protection, retail boxes and export identification are developed against a packaging brief.
